section: Convert from greased-for-life or regreaseable to oil-lubricated bearings
markdown:
| Pump model                  | Action                                                 |
|-----------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
| STi                         | Remove the epoxy from the return slot.                 |
| MTi, LTi , XLT-i , and i-17 | Remove the set screw installed in the oil-return hole. |
